title: The first benchmark: the simple baseline won
summary: In a one-year backtest, guessing that the price stays the same produced less error than the forecasting model for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana.

title: Three virtual portfolios start with $10,000 each
summary: Every decision to buy, sell or wait is recorded with its market checks, costs and reason. A second run gives all three the same starting holdings.

title: The forecast journal scores every prediction in public
summary: Each forecast is frozen before its deadline and compared with the observed price afterwards. Misses stay on the record.

title: Field notes 002-004: where we looked, what survived
summary: No horizon rescues the model, uncertainty is easier to forecast than direction, and a slow trend filter halved the deepest loss in a six-year backtest without earning more.

title: A trend experiment joins the paper portfolios
summary: A fixed rule with no forecast and no news: hold each coin in proportion to its positive 7-, 14-, 28- and 56-day returns. It runs against a rebalanced portfolio and buy & hold, as the prospective test of our own backtest.

title: Every simulated trade now says why
summary: Each trade carries the reason of the decision behind it, and decisions that led to a trade stay visible after hours of later holds.

title: A simple volatility band challenges the model's own range
summary: Four fitted numbers against the forecasting model's uncertainty band, from one hour to three days ahead, scored on identical forecasts with a fixed 28-day review.

title: Field notes by email, in a trial run
summary: A weekly mail with the forecasts against reality, the open claims for the next day, the portfolios, the headlines and what changed. It is being test-run before sign-up opens. Double opt-in and no tracking of opens or clicks are built in.
